text: That afternoon: Holmes speaks of a clever man turned to crime and proposes to walk out upon the lawn
why: The story has Holmes say 'when a clever man turns his brains to crime' and propose walking out upon the lawn (¶172). Earlier, ¶125 greets Miss Stoner with 'Good-afternoon' and ¶126 places the visit after the morning, so 'That afternoon' is also established.
